node: Supply-chain visibility, compliance, traceability, and contractor risk software
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe for the supply-chain visibility/compliance node. The best underfollowed fit found in this pass is Telos, because its Xacta offering maps directly to federal cyber risk, CMMC, and supply-chain risk management. Descartes is a second-order compliance-data candidate through denied-party, sanctions, export-control, and trade-compliance workflows used by aerospace/defense and supply-chain teams. Xometry is not a pure compliance-software vendor, but its marketplace, CMMC certification, government procurement positioning, and certified domestic supplier network make it relevant to contractor onboarding and capacity mapping. Palantir is included only as a high-attention reference anchor for defense data integration/readiness workflows; it should not crowd out the underfollowed lane.
